name: sas87_low
description: Low-end hardware — 2 GB VRAM target. Reduced density, minimal streaming.
notes: Target: ~2 GB VRAM, 8 GB RAM. Disables dual-pass, god rays, SSS, ped shadows, normal maps. Streaming 1024 MB, LOD 2.0. Car/ped density at 0.6x. Suitable for integrated graphics or low-end discrete GPUs (GTX 960, RX 560, Intel Arc A310).
